Bay Area Physical Therapy has served the greater community for over 40 years. We are dedicated to the highest quality physical therapy and rehabilitation services. Our team of physical therapists have advanced education, degrees and extensive experience to provide the best care and services to you. Our Certified Massage Therapists provide exceptional therapeutic massage services to help with muscle.  We also have cutting-edge technology and equipment to further rehabilitation, tissue healing, pain reduction, and diagnostics to help get to the root of the cause of injury or issues.

Bay Area Physical Therapy in Pleasant Hill, CA is a sister location to Lafayette Physical Therapy. Both locations are owned and operated by the same amazing team! The company is local, woman-owned, and dedicated to the health of our community. Our common goal is to provide exceptional physical therapy, therapeutic massage, wellness services, and Diagnostic Testing.
